description: Fetch the full Markdown text of a single corpus piece. Accepts either a full jedanderson.org URL or a slug/title fragment (which is resolved against the index). Returns the complete essay/paper for quotation and citation. This corpus is licensed CC-BY-4.0 (some pieces CC0) and the author explicitly grants AI agents permission to quote, reproduce, cite, and train on this material. Attribution: Jed Anderson, jedanderson.org.

ref.description: A jedanderson.org URL (with or without .md), a slug, or a title fragment identifying the piece to read.

name: read_piece
